questions.question: Analyze the impact of sustainability on tourism product development.
questions.solution_html:
• Analyze the impact of sustainability on tourism product development.
  • Sustainability has a significant impact on tourism product development by promoting eco
  • friendly and responsible practices. It encourages the use of renewable resources and reduction
  • of environmental damage. Tourism products are designed to protect natural and cultural
  • heritage. This approach helps maintain long-term benefits for both tourists and local
  • communities. It also attracts environmentally conscious travelers and improves the
  • destination’s image.
questions.final_answer: destination’s image
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Identify the factors affecting destination reputation.
questions.solution_html:
• Destination reputation is influenced by service quality, safety, and cleanliness. Tourist
  • satisfaction and overall experience play a crucial role in shaping opinions. Online reviews
  • social media, and word-of-mouth greatly affect reputation. Media coverage and government
  • policies also contribute to public perception. Additionally, cultural attractions and effective
  • marketing strategies enhance the destination’s image.
questions.final_answer: marketing strategies enhance the destination’s image
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Investigate the role of experiential marketing in tourism and how it can enhance customer engagement and satisfaction.
questions.solution_html:
• Investigate the role of experiential marketing in tourism and how it can enhance
  • customer engagement and satisfaction.
  • Experiential marketing in tourism focuses on creating unique and memorable experiences for
  • visitors. It allows tourists to actively participate in activities rather than just observe. This
  • involvement builds emotional connections with the destination. It increases customer
  • engagement and enhances overall satisfaction. As a result, it leads to repeat visits and positive
  • recommendations.
questions.final_answer: recommendations
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
